sloka: इमा: प्रकृतय: सर्वा विधवा मातरश्च या: ।त्वत्सकाशमनुप्राप्ता: प्रसादं कर्त्तुमर्हसि ॥ २.१०४.९॥
transliteration: imā: prakṛtaya: sarvā vidhavā mātaraśca yā: ।tvatsakāśamanuprāptā: prasādaṁ karttumarhasi ॥ 2.104.9॥

translations.english: All these subjects and your widowed mothers have come to you. It behoves you to grant them this favour.
